title: All-Hands Oct 2026 - Talking Points & Q&A (Draft)
content:
Draft notes for Redwood All-Hands (Oct 2026) - talking points + prep Q&A.

Opening (CEO / 7 mins)
- Quick welcome, gratitude for shipping Dedicated scale improvements and new private deployment early adopters.
- High-level: focus for Q4 - reliability, cost efficiency, and enterprise expansions.
- One-line wins: 25% lower p99 latency for medium chat workloads, 18% cost savings from Optimize recommendations in Beta.

Product highlights (Director of Product / 10 mins)
- Hosted API: streaming stability fixes rolled out in Sept; improved rate limit signalling (fewer 429s).
- Dedicated: GA of burst capacity policies (early customers report smoother spikes).
- Private: first pack installs in two regulated customers; positive initial audit feedback.
- Console: new per-route cost breakdowns + rollout UI for canaries (beta).
- Optimize: caching/quantization recommendations now include simulated unit-economics; still tuning for low-latency chat.

Metrics snapshot (30s)
- DAU of API calls up 12% MoM.
- Median latency: 210ms (stable); p99 improved from 1.8s -> 1.35s for target workloads.
- Monthly committed revenue growth: +9% QoQ.

Customer story (Customer Success / 3 mins)
- Highlight: EdgeWare (anonymized) moved from self-hosted to Redwood Dedicated; cut per-token infra cost by ~22% and hit 99.95% uptime SLA in pilot.

Engineering shoutouts (2 mins)
- Release-engineering & serving-runtime for kernel selection improvements.
- SRE for incident response runbook that reduced MTTR by 30%.

What's next (3 mins)
- Close gaps on latency SLOs for long-context workloads (research + infra work).
- Improve support for private air-gapped installs (packaging + security checklist).
- Expand Optimize recommendations coverage for embeddings-heavy workloads.

Hiring & org notes (30s)
- Hiring: infra, applied-ML, and product-governance roles open. Please refer hires doc (linked).

Close (CEO / 1 min)
- Quick ask: bring one customer moment to the next all-hands.
- Call to action: share feedback on cadence and topics via the #all-hands-feedback thread.

Prepared Q&A (anticipated; editable)
Q: We saw an outage last month - what happened and how are we preventing recurrence?
A: Root cause: autoscaler bug under certain burst patterns; immediate mitigations included manual capacity bump and rollout of a hotfix. Longer term: autoscaler redesign to better simulate burst workloads in CI; we added canary traffic for autoscaler changes. Ticket: jira:INF-3247 (see linked).

Q: How are we measuring cost improvements from Optimize?
A: We run cohort A/B comparisons on representative workloads and project per-token unit economics; early customers show ~15-25% improvements depending on workload. We plan to add revenue-at-risk style dashboards in Console next quarter.

Q: Timeline for Private air-gapped GA?
A: Targeting late Q1 2027 for a hardened package with complete KMS/HSM integration and audited install playbook. Current priority is documentation and automated checks.

Q: Any changes to pricing or committed plans?
A: No immediate pricing changes planned. We are experimenting with new committed tiers for Dedicated (internal trials only). Will announce changes well in advance.

Notes to self / action items before finalizing slides:
- Confirm CEO opening line numbers with finance (ARR, committed rev growth) - missing exact percent in slide. (action: ask Noah Reed)
- Replace customer name with anonymized case study link and get CS approval (action: Asha).
- Attach demo video of Console rollout UI (small clip) - ask Lucas for screen recording.
- Final run-through with presenters Tuesday 10/13.

Unresolved/questions:
- Should we call out third-party infra partners by name? (legal check)
- Decide whether to include new hire headcount numbers in the org slide (pending finance).

Rough slide order (for presenter flow):
1) Welcome + company health snapshot
2) Product highlights (hosted/dedicated/private/console/optimize)
3) Metrics + customer story
4) Roadmap + hiring
5) Q&A

End of draft.

-- Samira
